title: TestIdentity
description: A synthetic principal the target establishes in its evaluation environment so an agent can act as a known user or service during evaluation (spec §8.2). Returned by GET /aep/identities and GET /aep/identities/{identityId}. Evaluators discover identities and bind one at session start by identityId; they never create them and never receive the identity's credentials (AEP-REQ-145). The document is descriptive: additionalProperties is false so no credential-shaped field can be added, and 'attributes' MUST NOT carry secrets or real PII (AEP-REQ-144).

identityId.description: Stable handle the evaluator passes as identityId at session start. Possession confers nothing: binding is authorized against the caller's own credential (AEP-REQ-145), so this need not be high-entropy and MAY be human-readable.

kind.description: 'user' — a synthetic end-user principal. 'service' — a non-human principal (integration, automation, agent-to-agent caller). Custom kinds use reverse-DNS prefixes.

description.description: What this identity is for: its role, what seeded data it can see, what it cannot do. Evaluators choose identities from this text.

tenantId.description: Evaluation tenant / workspace / organization the identity belongs to. MUST be an evaluation tenant, never a production tenant (AEP-REQ-086, AEP-REQ-130).

roles.description: Product-defined role labels the identity holds (e.g. 'workspace-admin', 'viewer'). Descriptive; the product's authorization layer remains authoritative.

attributes.description: Descriptive, non-secret attributes evaluators may filter or reason on (locale, seniority, plan tier, feature flags). MUST NOT contain credentials, tokens, or real personally identifiable information (AEP-REQ-144, AEP-REQ-145).

agentIds.description: Agents the CALLING IDENTITY may bind this identity to: the intersection of the identity's declared applicability and the caller's agent authorization (AEP-REQ-141). Computed per caller so the list never names an agent the caller cannot see. The literal '*' means every agent the caller is authorized to evaluate. Servers reject a binding outside this set with -32071 (AEP-REQ-148).

authorizedModes.description: Live evaluation modes in which the CALLING IDENTITY may bind this identity for a fresh session: the intersection of the identity's declared applicability and the caller's mode authorization, as authorizedModes on AgentSummary (AEP-REQ-026, AEP-REQ-141). 'replay' is deliberately not listable: replaying a Trace that recorded this identity is governed by the Trace's mode and AEP-REQ-046, not by this list (AEP-REQ-148, AEP-REQ-151). An identity whose fixture must never be mutated omits 'sandboxed-live'.

fixture.description: Seeded state behind the identity, when its behavior depends on any. Required for identities with seeded state (AEP-REQ-150).

maxConcurrentSessions.description: How many sessions may hold this identity at once. Identities with a per-session fixture reset are typically 1.

status.description: 'available' — may be bound now. 'unavailable' — exists and is applicable but cannot be bound now (reset in progress, at concurrency limit, maintenance); binding returns -32072. 'retired' — kept for Trace continuity; new bindings return -32072.

availableAt.description: When an 'unavailable' identity is expected to become available, if known.

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the identity document last changed. Drives the updatedSince filter.

version.description: Monotonic version string for the seeded state. Changes whenever the fixture content changes.

digest.description: Digest over a target-defined canonical serialization of the fixture state (AEP-REQ-150). Two bindings with equal digests saw equal state.

resetPolicy.description: 'none' — fixture is never reset (read-only identities). 'per-session' — restored to 'version' before every binding. 'scheduled' — restored on a target-defined schedule. 'on-demand' — restored when the target chooses; the Trace snapshot records what was seen.

IdentityBinding.title: IdentityBinding
IdentityBinding.description: Snapshot of a test identity as resolved when a session bound it (AEP-REQ-149). Recorded on EvaluationSession.identity and Trace.identity, and carried whole on the session.started stream event so Trace reconstruction from the stream stays lossless (AEP-REQ-114). tenancy, roles and fixture are present whenever the bound identity carries them. Carries no credentials (AEP-REQ-145).

authorizationRef.description: Opaque, high-entropy reference (AEP-REQ-126) to the audit record of the authorization decision that permitted this binding — which evaluator credential, under which scope, at what time (AEP-REQ-090, AEP-REQ-153). Joins the snapshot to the server's audit log without putting the evaluator's credential or scope on the Trace.

fixture.description: Fixture version and digest as observed at bind time; replay compares against these (AEP-REQ-151).
